note: Placements only (ADR-005): the textbook tree is subject-level content in curricula/math/. The four illustrative entries point into pilot-illustrative.json and are kept byte-identical so their URLs and saved snapshots keep working. The two PEP entries (R9 G3) point at the printed sections of the 2022-revision volumes in pep-math-2022.json: 8b 23.2 (graphs and properties of linear functions) and 9a 26.2 (graphs and properties of quadratic functions). Only those two sections suit this tool today - a linear graph and a parabola with sliders on k/b (or a/b/c) - and nothing else in the six volumes is mapped just to fill the directory. The same tool, one implementation: each entry differs in position, preset and text only.

title.zh-CN: 一次函数的斜率与截距
title.en: Slope and intercept of a linear function

summary.zh-CN: 以本章预置参数打开同一个函数实验：先看 k 与 b 如何移动直线，可在本章内保存自己的参数。
summary.en: Opens the same function experiment with this chapter's preset: watch how k and b move the line, then save your own parameters for this chapter.

summary.zh-CN: 以本章预置参数打开同一个函数实验：观察顶点位置与开口方向，本章的个人参数与上一章互不影响。
summary.en: Opens the same function experiment with this chapter's preset: study the vertex and the opening direction. Saved parameters in this chapter never leak into the previous one.

title.zh-CN: 先看顶点（示例乙的章序）

summary.zh-CN: 同一份实验，在示例教材乙里出现在前面的册与章；预置值与个人保存都只属于这个条目。
summary.en: The same experiment, placed in the earlier book and chapter of sample catalog B. Both the preset and any saved parameters belong to this entry only.

title.zh-CN: 后看斜率（示例乙的章序）

summary.zh-CN: 同一份实验，在示例教材乙的后一册与后一章；与示例甲的同名主题互不共享参数。
summary.en: The same experiment, in the later book and chapter of sample catalog B. It shares no parameters with the same topic in sample catalog A.

title.zh-CN: 一次函数的图象和性质
title.en: Graphs and properties of linear functions

summary.zh-CN: 以 23.2 节的预置参数打开同一个函数实验：拖动 k 与 b，观察直线如何升降、在 y 轴上从哪里穿过，再把看到的现象与课本第 117 页的性质逐条对照。这是本项目的独立实现，不含教材插图、例题或习题。
summary.en: Opens the same function experiment with section 23.2's preset: drag k and b to see how the line tilts and where it crosses the y-axis, then check each property you noticed against printed page 117. This is the project's own implementation; it embeds no textbook figure, worked example or exercise.

title.zh-CN: 二次函数的图象和性质
title.en: Graphs and properties of quadratic functions

summary.zh-CN: 以 26.2 节的预置参数打开同一个函数实验：改变 a、b、c，观察开口方向、对称轴与顶点如何变化，与课本第 33 页所讲的性质逐条对照。本节只是同一工具的另一个入口，参数与本节的个人保存都与 23.2 互不影响。
summary.en: Opens the same function experiment with section 26.2's preset: change a, b and c to watch the opening direction, axis of symmetry and vertex, and compare them with the properties on printed page 33. This is another entry into the same tool; its preset and its own saved values are independent of 23.2.
